content.text: (c) Check for 2 → 1 down-shift and abnormal noise at acceleration and deceleration, and for shock at up-shift and down-shift.
(a) While running above 80 km/h (50 mph) in the "D" range, release your foot from the accelerator pedal and shift into "L" range.
Then check to see that the 2 → 1 down shift point conforms to 53 km/h (33 mph).

content.description: Shift pattern showing D range to L range shift with notation 'Only Down-Shift' and '1 → 2' indicator

content.text: (b) While running in the "L" range, check to see that there is no up-shift to 2nd gear.

content.description: Diagram showing gear selector in L position with arrow pointing to gear 2, crossed out to indicate no upshift

content.text: (c) While running in "L" range, release the accelerator pedal and check the engine braking effect.

content.description: Diagram showing gear selector in L position with 1st gear indicator and engine braking symbol

content.text: (d) Check for abnormal noise at acceleration and deceleration.
